Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and hematuria, with urine culture confirming >100,000 CFU/mL Enterococcus faecalis, indicating a urinary tract infection. The low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
